score_precision: FP32 dot product of L2-normalized FP32 CLS vectors from frozen FP16 public encoder
semantic_output: one active canonical HPO ID; never inferred compound or NIL
nil_output: only unchanged strict literal unanimous train32 NIL
ambiguity: strict known ambiguity cannot invoke semantic fallback; public alias ambiguity yields tied concept scores
selection_basis: One prespecified conservative operating point before any train SapBERT scores or held model outputs. High cosine plus distinct-concept separation are engineering acceptance criteria, not calibrated probabilities. No threshold search.
diagnostic_scope: train32 target quotes only; report strict resubstitution, public-only and leave-one-document-out alias controls separately; no held/dev gold
